scenes.name: Classroom Window & Assembly Bell
scenes.subtitle: Nostalgic acoustic fingerstyle • Morning assembly bells echo across the campus

scenes.name: Assembly Prayer & Stolen Glances
scenes.subtitle: Folded hands in prayer • Eyes searching across the courtyard queue

lines.text: Subah ki assembly mein haath jab judte the,
Duaon ke beech nazrein bas tujhpe rukti thi.

scenes.name: Third Period Slanted Sunlight
scenes.subtitle: Warm light across wooden desks • Attention slipping from open pages

lines.text: Third period ki dhoop jab bench pe aati thi,
Mera dhyan kitaabon se chura le jaati thi.

scenes.name: Pencil Marks & Erased Initials
scenes.subtitle: Written in graphite, erased in fear • The deep impression that never leaves

lines.text: Pencil se likha tha tera naam desk par,
Darr ke maare haathon se mita diya maine,
Par panno pe chhoote woh gehre nishaan,
Aaj bhi kehte hain tujhko hi chaha maine.

scenes.name: Nostalgic Acoustic Interlude
scenes.subtitle: Warm nylon strings & cello • Dust floating in classroom light beams

scenes.name: Blackboard Notes & Stolen Glimpse
scenes.subtitle: Copying homework questions • Turning around on silly pretexts

lines.text: Woh blackboard se homework utaarna,
Bahaane se mud ke tujhe ek nazar taakna.

scenes.name: Roll Number Attendance
scenes.subtitle: A suspended breath when your number is called • The quiet voice that made the day

lines.text: Jab roll number tera bolti thi teacher,
Saansein meri rukti thi ek pal ke liye,
Tera woh dheeme se kehna "Present, Ma'am",

scenes.name: Tiffin Break & Silent Hesitation
scenes.subtitle: Laughter across the corridor • Never finding the courage to take a single step closer

lines.text: Kafi tha mere saare din ke jiye.
Tiffin ke break mein tu hansti thi dosto sang,
Door khade chadh jaata tha ek anokha rang.
Kabhi himmat na hui ke paas tere jaa saku,
Ek lafz bhi zubaan se keh ke jata saku.

scenes.name: Pencil Marks Reprise
scenes.subtitle: Rubbing away the lead with warm fingers • The paper still remembers

lines.text: Pencil se likha tha tera naam desk par,
Darr ke maare haathon se mita diya maine,
Par panno pe chhoote woh gehre nishaan,
Aaj bhi kehte hain tujhko hi chaha maine.

scenes.name: Rain & Piano Melancholy
scenes.subtitle: Rain drops on cycle seats • Early school dismissal bell

scenes.name: Cycle Stand & Yellow School Bus
scenes.subtitle: Pedaling slow in the rain • Waiting for her bus to pass behind

lines.text: Barsaat ke din jab chhutti hoti thi,
Cycle stand par bheed lagti thi bhaari.
Main jaan-boojh kar pedal dheere maarta,
Peeche se guzarti thi jab bus tumhaari.

scenes.name: Yellow Bus Window & Uniform Autographs
scenes.subtitle: Hair blowing in the bus window • Shirts signed with memories on the last day

lines.text: Woh yellow bus ki khidki, hawa mein udte baal,
Tujhe dekh ke mera kaisa hota tha haal.
Exam ke aakhri din sab autograph le rahe the,
Safed shirt pe doston ke naam beh rahe the.

scenes.name: The Unsaid Farewell
scenes.subtitle: Pen in trembling hands • Never uttering that last goodbye

lines.text: Kalam haath mein thi par main aage na badha,
Tujhse ek aakhri alvida bhi na keh saka.

scenes.name: The Old Bench & Sweetest Youth
scenes.subtitle: Years have slipped away • The wooden corner where innocent love lived

lines.text: Barson guzar gaye, school chhoot gaya,
Par purani bench ka kona nahi bhoola.
Shayad tu bhool gayi hogi woh saari baatein,
Par mere bachpan ka sabse pyara hissa tu thi,
Jise chaha bohot... par keh na saka.

scenes.name: The Final Glance That Stayed Forever
scenes.subtitle: So close in front, yet unaware • Just that single turn of your head

lines.text: Subah ki assembly...
Pencil ke nishaan...
Tu samne thi kitni,
Par anjaan thi meri jaan...
Bas ek mud ke dekhna tera,
Hamesha ke liye theher gaya...

scenes.name: Bicycle Bell & Blackboard Chalk Silence
scenes.subtitle: Guitar chords decaying in the afternoon air • An innocent love that never grew old
